## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (Top 5: 4/5 tech) and major divergence across large caps (multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches), so wait for clearer breadth confirmation.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing selective strength: PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND. Materials marginally positive: sector up 0.71% (11 stocks) with no single dominant SP100 leader this week.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +1.52%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +2.12%) CORRECTION, VLO (1W: -6.32% | 1M: +11.25%) CORRECTION. Utilities weak: NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND. Communication under pressure: CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND, WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — caution on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND, MPC (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +8.63%) CORRECTION, CCI (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Communication, Software and select Energy/Real Estate names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +10.70% | 1M: -5.35%) RECOVERY — watch SHOP, AMGN, MA as RECOVERY names with 1W/1M divergence.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but leadership concentrated; AAPL (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.53% | 1M: +3.99%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: -1.61% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION, ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND. Sector positive this week but internally bifurcated; breadth limited.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials weak overall; JPM (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -4.30%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: +0.43% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY — sector showing dispersion and contribution to neutral regime.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Selective strength: JNJ (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -5.51%) BELOW TREND — healthcare breadth stable but mixed.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Neutral stance with a Growth/Momentum tilt given concentrated tech leadership; favor selective tech leaders (QCOM, META, INTC) while reducing exposure to structurally weak Communication/Utilities names. Monitor RECOVERY names (SHOP, MA, AMGN) for follow-through but treat as tactical, not core, given major 1W/1M divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND, NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (one of 3 sectors positive) — watch leadership concentration and follow-through. BEARISH: Energy and Utilities — several large names in CORRECTION or BELOW TREND and negative 1W flows.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch tech leaders for confirmation of above-trend momentum (sustained weekly follow-through on QCOM/INTC/META). Trigger for broad improvement: expansion of positive sectors above 5/11 on 1W breadth; trigger for defensiveness: more large-cap outsized losses and defensives leading the 1W scoreboard.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
WBD (+80): WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND — deal-related bullish sentiment confirmed by strong price action. LLY (+60): LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) RECOVERY — positive news aligns with 1W bounce; watch for follow-through to lift 1M trend.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-85): BA (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND — news confirms ongoing softness. MPC (-50): MPC (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +8.63%) CORRECTION — negative sentiment aligns with sharp 1W pullback despite 1M gains. VLO (-45): VLO (1W: -6.32% | 1M: +11.25%) CORRECTION — sentiment and price both signal short-term exhaustion.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt. QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow tech leadership and major 1W/1M divergences (RECOVERY names SHOP, MA, AMGN vs BELOW TREND names ORCL, INTU, CHTR), monitor sentiment-driven moves for confirmation.
